aiSummary.oneLiner: A curated collection of practical, ready-to-run AI agents, multi-agent teams, and installable skills.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository is a massive, highly curated registry of pre-built AI agents, tools, and agent skills designed to be immediately runnable. It organizes content into distinct categories including installable CLI skills for coding agents, single-file starter agents for beginners, advanced multi-agent orchestrations for complex reasoning, and always-on background workers. Rather than just listing URLs, it provides actual implementable code templates using popular frameworks like Streamlit, CrewAI, and the OpenAI Agents SDK. This enables developers to instantly clone and execute full agentic workflows ranging from financial analysis to podcast generation.
keyFeatures: Installable agent skills: Provides CLI-installable tools that grant coding agents new capabilities like dependency checking and commit archaeology.
Starter agent templates: Includes single-file Python scripts that can be executed immediately with just an API key to demonstrate core concepts.
Multi-agent orchestrations: Includes complex, multi-step workflows utilizing teams of specialized agents for tasks like legal research and game design.
Always-on background workers: Contains persistent agents designed to run on schedules or events, such as daily Hacker News briefings.
Extensive framework coverage: Demonstrates implementations across various models and frameworks including Gemini, Grok, Claude, and DeepSeek R1.
